items.question: How are mandala varieties ordered for victory health and other success?
premises: Mandala varieties are arranged especially for success.
The mode of practices will be stated in the chapter.
items.inference: The text lists mandala forms and their ordered varieties for ritual success.
uncertainties: Exact ritual application of each mandala form is not specified here.
items.plain_english: Especially for victory, health, and other success, the mode of practices will be well stated in the chapter; by ghatika-order yoga they undergo rotation; circle thirty-six-sided and likewise eighteen-sided; mandala-making; square and triangle thus nine varieties in order.
